direct_launch.reason: No stable documented pre-discovery SessionStart command hook is confirmed.

sources.observation: Plugins load at startup and session.created is listed only as an event; no pre-discovery ordering guarantee is documented.
Plugin initialization precedes the other bootstrap services, but this is not a documented SessionStart command-hook contract.
Stable plugins receive session events through the event listener; no synchronous pre-discovery SessionStart command hook is exposed.
Skill discovery is materialized through per-instance state from configured directories.
The V2 plugin API is explicitly beta and is not used for the release path.
Declarative native session lifecycle hooks were requested and the issue was closed as not planned.
